candidate_mechanism: Deterministic pre-effect claim barrier keyed by H(predecessor_blob || next_effect_key || assignment_task_id), with create-if-absent claim before effect and later canonical successor/terminal receipt.

tested_scope.effect_type: non-idempotent or externally visible logical effect whose completion is not atomically committed with the role-local claim
tested_scope.failure_point: winner crashes after durable claim creation, either immediately before the effect or immediately after the effect but before durable successor/terminal evidence
tested_scope.observer: second recurring Chat invocation sees only role-local durable claim plus absence of successor
not_tested: lease or timeout policies under delayed visibility

recovery_rule_cases.rule: writer2 executes E because successor is absent
writer2 never executes E while claim C exists
recovery_rule_cases.history_A: effect can remain permanently missing; recovery liveness violated

finding: A pre-effect claim barrier alone removes the two-writer pre-execution race but cannot simultaneously guarantee at-most-once execution and crash recovery for a non-idempotent effect when claim creation and effect completion are not one atomic durable operation. Crash-before-effect and effect-then-crash are observationally identical to the next invocation if only the claim and missing successor are available.
revision: Treat the claim as admission only, not as an exactly-once certificate. For positive Phase-1 use, require the effect itself to be replay-safe under the deterministic claim_id (idempotent/deduplicated), or make the durable repository CAS/create keyed by claim_id be the effect/commit boundary. A timeout/lease by itself does not resolve the indistinguishability.
recovery_certificate_requirement: No second executor may run a non-idempotent effect after observing an existing claim unless role-local durable evidence proves the prior effect cannot have occurred. In the tested claim-only state such a certificate is unavailable, so the mechanism remains unresolved for non-idempotent effects.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded exact-path role-local state/evidence transport only; no hosted compute
mechanism_assessment.reason: winner-crash ambiguity remains unresolved for non-idempotent effects

scope_guard: This falsification applies only when claim creation and effect completion are not atomic and the effect is not replay-safe. It does not falsify claim+idempotent-effect or atomic effect-commit designs.
exact_continuation: On the next valid invocation, test exactly one transient exact-path-not-visible interleaving for the deterministic claim path: a real claim exists but one read returns missing/unavailable. Require that a single ambiguous miss never authorizes effect execution or completion, define the smallest zero-quota role-local read/visibility certificate that safely distinguishes confirmed absence from transient non-observation, and preserve claim+idempotent-effect crash recovery as the subsequent unresolved child. Persist/read back one bounded result and stop.
